purpose: Classification for every test script that is not directly named by verify.sh.
classificationRule: A tests/*.cjs file named directly by verify.sh is current. Exceptions below record orphaned scripts that need an explicit classification.

statuses.verify: Current automated test; verify.sh runs it through the manifest extras block.
statuses.manual: Human-run utility or manual QA support; not part of automated verification.
statuses.superseded: Historical test whose assumptions no longer match the current implementation; retained for audit history.
statuses.obsolete: No longer relevant to the production surface; retained until an approved cleanup pass.
statuses.uncertain: Needs owner review before it can be treated as current or retired.
